subject: Audit log export: streaming vs. batch + signed-manifest options
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Aaron Park <aaron.park@brightlinehealth.com>, Brightline Security <security@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: audit export options and signing for SOC2 evidence

Hi Vivek —

We're starting to scope the SOC 2 evidence handoff for Brightline and need clarity on a few things related to admin / operator activity exports. Specifically:

1) What admin actions are captured today (login, role change, policy update, console/API actions, KMS key ops, session termination, etc.)? Are there any gaps we should expect?
2) Can you support a 365-day retention window for a customer (we saw 90 days in the docs)?
3) Export options: streaming (Kafka/Kinesis) vs daily batch (S3/HTTPS). What formats, compressions, and manifests do you provide?
4) Do you provide a signed manifest with SHA256 checksums and an attestation header (who signed it / signing key)?
5) Transport and encryption: SFTP with PGP encryption vs HTTPS pull; any preference/restrictions from your side?
6) Is sampling/partial-slice export possible (e.g., tenant-only, time-windowed subset)?

We're aiming for an auditor-ready handoff on Monday 15 Mar. Can you outline a delivery plan and tell us what artifacts you'll include?

Thanks,
Sarah
Security & Compliance
Brightline Health

[attachment: auditor-requirements-brightline.pdf (PDF, 34KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Aaron Park <aaron.park@brightlinehealth.com>, Brightline Security <security@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: audit export options and signing for SOC2 evidence

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear list. Below is a compact response and a proposed delivery plan. I attached a tiny sample CSV extract and an export-manifest template for your reviewers.

What we log (hosted + dedicated):
- Authentication events (successful/failed logins, MFA failures)
- Administrative actions (role grants/revocations, team membership changes)
- Configuration changes (routing policy edits, model pinning, rollout toggles)
- Operator console actions (start/stop jobs, instance reprovisioning)
- API-level management calls (key creation/rotation, endpoint config changes)
- KV/cache purge and cache eviction events (operator-triggered)
- System-level events (node reboots, scaling events)

Gaps/notes:
- PII is not stored in the admin event rows; where a user id appears it's an internal identifier.
- Dedicated/private customers can request extended retention or on-prem persistence for longer windows.

Retention options:
- Default hosted retention: 90 days
- Enterprise option: 365 days (available as a contract config for Dedicated and Private)
- For your requested 365-day window we can enable an export/replication policy that keeps events in your encrypted S3 bucket for the requested window.

Export modes we offer:
1) Near-realtime streaming (Kafka-compatible endpoint or cloud-native streaming): JSON lines, compressed (gzip), TLS to customer-controlled consumer.
2) Daily batch: newline-delimited JSON (.jsonl) or CSV, gzipped, uploaded to S3 or pushed to an SFTP server.
3) On-demand snapshot: time-windowed ZIP bundles with manifest, checksums, and signed attestation.

Manifest and attestation:
- We produce an export-manifest.json for each bundle (fields: filename, size_bytes, sha256, record_count, time_range, issuer, signed_by).
- We can sign manifests with our key and provide the public PGP key (attached: redwood_pgp_pubkey.asc).
- We also provide a detached SHA256 checksum listing and a signed manifest signature (.sig).

Transport and encryption:
- SFTP + PGP (customer publishes PGP pubkey): recommended for batch delivery to private buckets.
- HTTPS pull with signed URLs: suitable for secured automated ingestion.
- Streaming over TLS: for near-realtime integration.

Sampling / slice exports:
- We support tenant-scoped exports and arbitrary time windows. We can produce slices (e.g., 2026-02-01T00:00:00Z to 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z) and filter by resource types.

Proposed delivery plan for Monday 15 Mar (auditor-ready):
- Friday 12 Mar: confirm scope (time window, tenant ids, export format)
- Mon 15 Mar 02:00-04:00 UTC: produce snapshot bundle and upload to your SFTP (or S3 path)
- Mon 15 Mar 05:00 UTC: we send signed manifest, SHA256 listing, PGP signature, and manifest-signer cert chain to your security mailbox
- Post-delivery: 72-hour window for validation and one support escalation call.

Attachments included: admin-log-sample.csv, export-manifest-template.json, redwood_pgp_pubkey.asc

Could you confirm (by EOD today) the desired format (jsonl vs csv), the target transport (SFTP vs S3), and the exact time window you want exported? Once we have that we'll lock the runbook.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference

[attachment: admin-log-sample.csv (CSV, 12KB)]
[attachment: export-manifest-template.json (JSON, 4KB)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: audit export options and signing for SOC2 evidence — coordination

Team —

Forwarding Brightline's request (below). They're asking for a 365-day retention export and signed manifests. Ask: can we do a one-off 365-day snapshot replication into their S3 and produce a signed manifest using our standard key?

Ben — please confirm runbook (SFTP vs S3 push), estimated job runtime for a 365-day tenant export, and any cost uplift.
Olga — please confirm any compliance checks we need to run on the manifest signer chain before handing it over to an external auditor.

I want to confirm to Brightline by EOD so we can lock the Monday handoff.

Thanks,
Vivek

--- original message follows ---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: audit export options and signing for SOC2 evidence — coordination

Vivek —

We can do the 365-day replication into their S3 and also push a zipped bundle to SFTP. Job for a single-tenant 365-day export (admin events only) estimates: 45–90 minutes depending on window and sequence lengths.

Cost uplift: roughly 2–3x normal one-day snapshot (compute and egress). I will draft a short runbook and flag retention toggle as an enterprise contract change.

I'll have the runbook ready in the next 3 hours.

Ben

From: Aaron Park <aaron.park@brightlinehealth.com>

Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log export: streaming vs. batch + signed-manifest options

Thanks Vivek — that all looks good. Two quick asks before we confirm:

1) Please provide the PGP public key you will use for signing (or confirm you'll accept our pubkey for encrypting payloads).
2) Confirm the exact UTC window you plan to export for (we want 2025-03-01 through 2026-02-28).

If we can get the pubkey and an SFTP path + credentials we'll whitelist your IPs and move forward.

Aaron
Brightline — Security Engineering

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aaron Park <aaron.park@brightlinehealth.com>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 07:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit log export: streaming vs. batch + signed-manifest options — final plan

Hi Aaron / Sarah —

Confirming final plan: we will produce a time-windowed snapshot for 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-02-28T23:59:59Z and deliver it via SFTP to the path you provide. Timeline:

- Export run: 2026-03-15 02:00–03:30 UTC (estimated; job may complete earlier).
- Delivery: upload to SFTP as a gzipped bundle (admin-events-20250301_20260228.zip.gz).
- Artifacts: admin-events CSVs/JSONL by day, export-manifest.json (signed), manifest.sha256, manifest.sig, and redwood_pgp_pubkey.asc.
- Signing: manifest signed with Redwood's PGP key (attached); we will also include the certificate chain and the detached signature.
- Verification: you should be able to run sha256sum against the bundle and verify the detached signature with the attached PGP key.

PGP pubkey (attached): redwood_pgp_pubkey.asc
SFTP preference accepted. Please reply with the destination path, username, and PGP pubkey (if you prefer us to encrypt payloads with your key instead of our signed manifests).

We'll hold a 30-minute validation window on Mon 15 Mar at 10:00 UTC for auditors; invite details once you confirm the transport.

Thanks — we will schedule the job and share the runbook link once Ben posts it.

Vivek
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
